items.text: Cher's "Believe" reached number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1999, her first number-one single since 1974.
items.question: Where were you living when Cher's "Believe" was on the radio, and who in your life could not stop singing it?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart that ranks the best singles of the United States. Published by Billboard magazine, the data are compiled by Nielsen SoundScan based collectively on each single's weekly physical sales and airplays. There were 15 singles that topped the chart this year.
Pop singer Cher earned her first number-one single since 1974 and fifth overall when "Believe" topped the chart.

items.text: SpongeBob SquarePants debuted on Nickelodeon on May 1, 1999.
items.question: Who was the first person in your family to watch SpongeBob SquarePants, and did you end up watching it too?
items.source_quote: May 1 – The animated children's television series SpongeBob SquarePants debuts on the cable network Nickelodeon.

items.text: On July 10, 1999, Brandi Chastain scored the game winning penalty kick against China in the FIFA Women's World Cup.
items.question: Where were you when Brandi Chastain scored the winning kick against China, and who was watching with you?
items.source_quote: July 10 – U.S. soccer player Brandi Chastain scores the game winning penalty kick against China in the FIFA Women's World Cup.
